title: Incandescent Manipulations
subtitle: Lux - blood remembers light
text: The Incandescent tendency belongs to blood that has witnessed things that glow. Hematic Flare (QUICK, 125) lashes concealed targets with revealing blood-light. Crimson Sight (QUICK, 250) grants night vision and marks nearby mobs. Prismatic Reproof (QUICK, 325) blinds and weakens enemies in a cone, striking marked targets harder. Hematic Beacon (QUICK, 350) creates an aimed blood-light rally point that reveals mobs and steadies allies. Lumen Suture (QUICK, 250) grants absorption to a wounded ally and clears blindness.
